description: The fallback and live layers stay mounted for recovery. A transition event or one-time timeout marks the live layer ready, and one guarded state update disables the loop.
expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner before manually reviewing the frame callback
Keeps both layers mounted so retry can show the fallback without rebuilding either layer
Keeps the transition event and one backup timeout because either can mark the live layer ready
Classifies the one-time state update as no change because the callback sets its guard before setting enabled to false
Moves values that change every frame to refs or DOM writes
